FAQS.a: Every user on your Enterprise plan can run as many builds as they want with no hour caps. The AI agent works continuously — no top-up packs, no monthly limits, no throttling.

Enterprise is billed annually based on the number of users in your organization: 1 user at $499/year, 2–5 users at $699/year, 6–10 users at $899/year. Teams of 11 or more get a custom quote tailored to your headcount and usage.
Yes. Adding users mid-year is prorated to your renewal date. Your account manager will handle the billing adjustment — no need to wait until renewal.

FAQS.q: What is included in the architecture review calls?
FAQS.a: Before a major build, a senior SynTract Labs engineer reviews your project scope, technology choices, and system design with your team. These calls catch architectural issues before the agent starts building, saving significant rework time.

FAQS.q: Do we own all the code the agent produces?
FAQS.a: Yes — 100%. All source code, assets, and intellectual property generated for every build belong to your organization. We retain no rights to anything the agent produces for you.
Most Enterprise teams are fully onboarded within one week. We assign a dedicated solutions engineer who handles account setup, team provisioning, and a kickoff call to align on your first builds.
